contracts.title: Master Services Agreement – Business ERP Hosting

clauses.title: Fees
clauses.text: The Customer pays a monthly fee of EUR 9,800.00 (net) for the Business ERP Hosting plan, invoiced on the 15th of each month.

clauses.title: Price guarantee
clauses.text: The fees under §5.1 are fixed for a period of 24 months from the commencement date (1 September 2025). Price increases during this period are excluded.

clauses.title: Price adjustments after the fixed period
clauses.text: After expiry of the price guarantee, the Provider may adjust the fees with at least three (3) months' written notice. The Customer may terminate the agreement with effect from the date of the adjustment.

clauses.title: Term
clauses.text: The agreement runs for an initial term of 36 months and renews automatically for 12 months unless terminated with 3 months' notice.

clauses.title: Price indexation
clauses.text: Prices are adjusted once per calendar year in line with the German consumer price index (VPI), by no more than 5% per year.

clauses.title: Notice
clauses.text: Price adjustments under §4.1 must be announced in text form at least 30 days before they take effect.
